components.text: Current entry rules for Indian passports
Thailand’s official notices show a changed regime in 6, so stay period depends on the effective date; the most recent embassy notice says the new 3-day exemption starts from 19 6.
Vietnam remains the simplest to state: Indian ordinary passport holders need a visa, and the official e-visa route is the normal path.
Sri Lanka’s official pages confirm ETA and a 0-day tourist period, but available snippets do not clearly state a current India-specific fee, so I cannot confirm figure with confidence.
